rules.name: inspect_before_acting
rules.summary: Resolve repository, branch, dirty state, conventions, and relevant files before changes.

rules.name: preserve_user_work
rules.summary: Never discard, overwrite, reset, clean, or replace unapproved user changes.

rules.name: protect_forks_and_upstreams
rules.summary: No unauthorized fork, upstream, or protected-branch writes.

rules.name: plan_before_mutation
rules.summary: Require bounded paths, operations, risks, and acceptance criteria.

rules.name: least_change
rules.summary: Avoid unrelated refactors, mass formatting, and speculative scope.

rules.name: approval_for_consequential_changes
rules.summary: Require explicit approval for destructive, external, broad, or security-sensitive actions.

rules.name: no_fabricated_quality
rules.summary: Never fabricate tests, benchmarks, coverage, security results, or adoption metrics.

rules.name: honest_validation
rules.summary: Report exact commands, environment, commit, failures, and skipped checks.

rules.name: untrusted_code_execution
rules.summary: Do not execute repository-controlled code without explicit authorization and suitable isolation.

rules.name: secrets_and_data_provenance
rules.summary: Prevent secret exposure and preserve data provenance and licensing.

rules.name: verify_every_write
rules.summary: Inspect every diff and validate the final tree.

rules.name: truthful_reporting
rules.summary: Separate implemented, proposed, tested, untested, blocked, and failed work.

notes: Controls currently apply to the legacy local ActionRunner and pipeline path, not every RepoForge execution path.
Dry-run preview does not mutate files and does not require approval.
Git checkpoint records a clean HEAD without staging or committing user files.
A passing test suite is required before claiming verified enforcement.
implemented_controls: RF-02: clean working-tree preflight and no staging user changes
RF-03: deny local writes on protected branch names
RF-06: exact path approval and separate delete approval
RF-11: full-batch preflight before first mutation
